rules: These are individual supplier offers, public fees or awarded maintenance prices, never a survey of regional averages.
No tonne/yard/compacted-volume conversion has been assumed.
Check date is not effective date, validity guarantee or supplier-confirmed availability.
Unknown inclusions remain unknown; missing quote prices are null, never zero.
No record changes a PGMaps project estimate automatically.
Supplier-haul and municipal-reference rows have separate categories from construction material offers.
